<fidel-code-block>

Code block. Code that a screen reader and a Braille display can read: Copy, Read line by line, Symbols as words, and "Play from 1:23".

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Blind learners and coders: speech mangles symbols and Python indentation, and a Braille display needs real text.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

for i in range(3):
    print(i)

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-code-block language="python" label="Example: a loop">
<pre><code>for i in range(3):
    print(i)</code></pre>
</fidel-code-block>

Source: player/src/components/a/code-block.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-code-block>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
labeltext"language code"Visible name of the code.
languagetextnoneProgramming language, e.g. python, html.
atm:ssnoneTime in the video: shows "From the video at 1:23" and a "Play from" button.
forid of a <fidel-player> or <video>the first <fidel-player>The video to play.
symbolsoffwordsoff starts the line view with symbols shown as symbols.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-code-block>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-code-block-copy{}The code was copied.
fidel-code-block-play{ seconds }"Play from" was used.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Copy, Read line by line and Symbols as words are real buttons.
  • In the line view, the Up and Down arrow keys move between lines (one Tab stop). Each line is read with its indent: "Line 2 of 3, indent 4 spaces: print open bracket i close bracket".
  • Escape stops reading. Line numbers are hidden from screen readers.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English. Code itself is marked lang="en".

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.1.1 Non-text Content: Code is real text, never an image.
  • 1.4.10 Reflow: Long code scrolls inside its own focusable box (an allowed exception).
  • 2.1.1 Keyboard: All buttons; arrow keys in the line view.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: "Copied" is announced.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
